menus:
  - id: menu.conditions
    key: menu.conditions
    udi: prismata.menu.conditions
    name: Conditional Menu
    title: Conditional Menu
    label: Conditional Menu
    position: Main
    order: 10
    type: main
    icon: "⚖️"
    colourScheme: main-menu
    borderScheme: default
    description: Demonstrates menu- and item-level condition handling.
    visibilityMode: Conditional
    visibilityCondition: feature_flag('conditional_menu') == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - conditional_menu
    enableMode: Conditional
    enableCondition: env('ENABLE_CONDITIONAL_MENU') == true
    enableDependencies:
      - ENABLE_CONDITIONAL_MENU
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.conditions.header
      text: Conditional Menu
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: feature_flag('conditional_menu') == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - conditional_menu
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.conditions.footer
      text: Conditional menu footer.
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: config_exists('conditions.yaml') == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - conditions_config
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.conditions.item1
        key: conditional.item1
        name: Only if feature enabled
        label: Only if feature enabled
        type: action
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.conditions.execute
        executeTarget: conditional_action
        icon: "🔍"
        visibilityMode: Conditional
        visibilityCondition: feature_flag('conditional_item') == true
        visibilityDependencies:
          - conditional_item
        enableMode: Conditional
        enableCondition: project_has_tag('beta') == true
        enableDependencies:
          - beta
